curriculum.name: count_requests_by_at
curriculum.goal: Given a person and a time, return how many requests that person made for that time.
curriculum.gold:
PROCEDURE count_requests_by_at(person:PERSON, time:TIME)
$v0 = FIND REQUEST WHERE SELF.WHO={person} SELF.WHEN={time}
$v1 = COUNT $v0
RETURN $v1
END
